attchmntText: Crown Lifters Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "CMD Statement   Q2 & Half-Yearly FY 2026 27 Business Update".
voiceSummary: Crown Lifters Limited filed an investor press release regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a turnover of 14.80 crore for the six-month period. The Chairman and Managing Director, Jaria Karim, stated that the EBITDA margin from Crown-owned crane operations remained healthy at approximately 55 to 56 percent. The firm sold selected cranes older than 15 years, reducing the weighted average fleet age to just over three years. Mr. Vinay Shetty was appointed as Chief Operating Officer. The company plans to procure higher-tonnage cranes from the fourth quarter of FY 2026–27, subject to financing arrangements. Fleet occupancy is expected to remain above 90 percent for the remainder of the financial year.

attchmntText: Crown Lifters Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Vinay Shetty as a Chief Operating Officer of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Crown Lifters Limited has appointed Mr. Vinay Shetty as Chief Operating Officer effective November 12, 2026. The appointment was approved by the board and committee. Mr. Shetty brings over 20 years of leadership experience in equipment rental, contract logistics, warehousing, supply chain, and business operations. He previously held senior roles at Allcargo Logistics and Supreme SCS. At Allcargo Logistics, he managed pan-India equipment rental and transportation operations. As COO of Supreme SCS, he helped expand the warehousing network. He founded Cargopulse.com. Mr. Shetty is an alumnus of IIM Lucknow and NMIMS Mumbai. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering and is a Certified Six Sigma Black Belt. At Crown Lifters, he will focus on operational excellence, asset utilization, sustainable business growth, and building scalable processes. There are no disclosed relationships between directors.

attchmntText: Crown Lifters Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Crown Lifters Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for the half year was 2670.64 lakh rupees, with a net profit of 169.82 lakh rupees. The company appointed Mr. Vinay Shetty as Chief Operating Officer. It also finalized contractual terms to invest in higher-tonnage cranes for the Green Energy sector, subject to delivery and funding. The Board approved the results following a limited review by statutory auditors Vishwas and Associates.
